Title: Generally available: A new and improved alert rule creation experience

Body.Content:
The Azure portal experience for creating an alert rule has been simplified and converted into a step wizard, which is now generally available. The main benefits of this new experience are:

  • Breaking the flow into smaller logical steps, making it easier to follow.
  • Support for creating resource-centric log alert rules from the Azure Monitor > Alerts experience (previously this was only possible when initiating the alert rule creation from the resource’s logs screen).
  • Simplifying the content to help complete the flow more easily.
  • Aligning with the portal’s design pattern for resource creation

Learn how to create an activity log alert rule in the Azure portal on process to Azure wizard experiences.

Learn how to create a metric alert rule in the Azure portal
